How do you differentiate between items made in China for China and those made for export?

Generally speaking they either have no (recognizable) branding, branding in Chinese characters, or branding that's an obvious knockoff of a namebrand product, lots of Engrish on the packaging, instructions in Chinese (possibly with an Engrish translation), and you can't buy them at brick and mortar stores in the US except for the kind of place I like to call a Chinese dollar store (which tend to be small businesses run by Chinese immigrants that sell stuff the owner had imported, rather than going through a major stateside distributor). With electronics in particular there's usually 10 different brands all selling an identical item with a different logo slapped on it, sometimes with half a dozen more selling the same guts in a different case.
